page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.6xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.5 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 192 GB of RAM, establishing an 8 GB per vCPU memory allocation ratio. The instance includes 35 MB of shared L3 cache and supports AVX-512 vector extensions alongside AES cryptography acceleration. It does not bundle local disk storage, requiring external cloud storage volumes, and offers a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps without discrete GPU hardware.

Benchmark results reveal that single-threaded CPU processing constitutes a significant performance constraint, with Geekbench single-core scoring 935.0 and stress-ng recording 1108.98, placing it in the lower percentiles. Compression speeds reflect this behavior, registering 18.91 GB/sec in single-threaded gzip. Conversely, multi-threaded aggregate performance aligns with mid-tier industry expectations, producing a Geekbench multi-core score of 7163.0 and a PassMark CPU score of 18392.83. Memory subsystem benchmarks show uncached read speeds of 96.89 GB/sec and write bandwidth of 52.55 GB/sec, supporting steady throughput across concurrent tasks.

The 1:8 compute-to-memory ratio provides a practical profile for memory-intensive workloads that do not demand cutting-edge per-thread execution speeds. The instance delivers solid results in memory-resident data operations, achieving 16.8 million operations per second in Redis SET evaluations and maintaining 10.83 GB/sec in static web serving throughput. However, the 4 Gbps baseline network capacity and reliance on remote storage may restrict high-throughput I/O pipelines. Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.6xlarge is best matched for distributed caching layers, in-memory databases, medium-scale enterprise application servers, and memory-heavy batch processing pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual instance built on the x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The configuration allocates 24 dedicated vCPUs across 12 physical cores, 192 GB of system RAM, and a 4 Gbps baseline network interface. It contains no bundled local storage and no GPU hardware. Synthetic benchmarks indicate weak single-core processing capabilities, offset by solid mid-range multi-core aggregate throughput and balanced uncached memory bandwidth of 96.89 GB/sec read and 52.55 GB/sec write. In-memory data throughput is reliable, demonstrated by 16.8 million operations per second in Redis SET tests. Because execution speed per thread is modest and local storage is omitted, the instance presents an effective architecture specifically for memory-bound applications, including distributed key-value stores, in-memory caching tiers, enterprise relational databases, and background ETL jobs.
